label: The time N independent substitutions need lies between N/(M mu) and N/mu
statement_en: With M gene copies, mutation rate mu per copy per generation and fixation probability u, the expected time for N substitutions arriving at Kimura's rate M mu u is N/(M mu u); for 1/M <= u <= 1 it lies between N/(M mu) and N/mu, and equals N/mu in the neutral case u = 1/M. An available time below N/(M mu), the fastest the model allows because it assumes every single mutant fixes, is ruled out.

hypotheses.name: genotype-substitution-time#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: Independent sequential fixations at Kimura's definition rate with constant M, mu and u: no linkage, no standing variation, no recombination of partial solutions.

hypotheses.name: genotype-substitution-time#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: That the number of required substitutions is given. It is not defined for any wing claim here, which is why this bound eliminates nothing about the flying fish.

hypotheses.name: genotype-substitution-time#assumed-3
hypotheses.statement: Nothing about whether the required substitutions exist, are favoured, or produce the trait.
